actions.message: Great job! Your strong contribution keeps the pool growing for everyone.

answer.explanation: Wallet >50%, average contribution >45% so baseline 80% applies; no need to contribute extra. Resident5 has contributed <10% for multiple consecutive rounds, so punish per constitution. Praise Resident6 for high contribution.

message.reasoning:
We need decide action round 15. Wallet 110.46, >50% initial, so baseline 80% contribution = 0.8*110.46 = 88.368. Average contribution? Compute recent rounds contributions: round14 total_pool 379.9 divided by6 =63.316 per agent share but contributions: Resident1 60,2 60,3 60,4 61.98,5 0,6 137.92. Sum contributions = 379.9. Average contribution = 379.9/6 =63.317 which as % of endowment 100 is 63.3% >45%, so baseline applies, no increase.

Check punish: any agent contributed <10% endowment (10) for two consecutive rounds? Look at history: Resident5 contributed 0 in rounds 10-14 all zeros -> that's >2 rounds low. So punish Resident5. Amount severity 10 per constitution. Cost to us = 0.3*10=3, we have enough. Also Resident3 contributed 60 in round14, but earlier zero? Round13 0, round12 0, round11 0, round10 0, but need two consecutive rounds of <10. He had many, but also contributed 60 in round14, so not two consecutive now. We'll punish Resident5.

We can also send private praise to a high contributor >=60% of wallet: our wallet 110, 60% =66. So who contributed >=66? Resident6 contributed 137.92 >66. So private message to Resident6 praising.

We can also broadcast norm if round 15 is multiple of5? Norm every 5 rounds starting at 1. Rounds 1,6,11,16... Actually first round broadcast, then every 5 rounds thereafter: 1,6,11,16. Round15 not needed. So only one physical action (punish) and one communication (private_message). That's allowed.
